B01_partvtk_binding.evidence: read_bound(cfg['partvtk'], 8 MiB) now performs canonical no-link/O_NOFOLLOW regular-file, exact-byte, exact-SHA, and stable-identity validation; the initial executable signature is regular+executable, checked before each frame, and the exact binding is re-read/hashed and re-statted after the loop.

B02_diagnostics_budget.evidence: The replacement runner preserves the v4 argv and 300-second timeout while sending both stdout and stderr to DEVNULL. The contract explicitly records zero captured PartVTK diagnostic bytes; shared-v14 remains responsible for the bounded aggregate child stdout.

B03_scratch_boundary.evidence: The .tmp parent is canonical/no-link checked, opened with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW, owned by the effective UID, and retained through a held descriptor. scratch_stable rechecks path/fd device, inode, mode, and owner before and after each frame; each private child is separately no-link checked and the configured per-frame cap is consumed.

B04_contract_scope_joins.evidence: The source now asserts frames, particles, native count, time tolerance, and the complete frozen resource map; native content hash joins expected_native_tree_sha256 and the paid prior tree; frame iteration, scratch cap, result time tolerance, and report requested_frames consume the asserted pins.

unchanged_trace.comparator: The v4 comparator path/bytes/SHA is unchanged. Its 13-column API, finite reader substitution, identity/Type/Mk/row coverage, numeric tolerances, and time semantics remain the reviewed legacy comparator.
unchanged_trace.hdf: The exact HDF remains O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW through a held descriptor with pre/post SHA and identity checks; no HDF conversion or new HDF is introduced.
unchanged_trace.native: The same native dataRoot receives pre/post signature inventories and raw manifests; symlink and file-count guards remain active.
unchanged_trace.scope: The 101-frame stop-on-first-negative behavior, temporary CSV policy, zero science/core credit, and no-G1/G2/core limits are unchanged.

decision.bounded_meaning: This is a static source acceptance only. A positive live result would mean exact saved-frame PartVTK/HDF consistency under the frozen printed tolerances, not G1, G2, solver, or core qualification.
decision.live_prerequisite: Root must still use canonical shared S01/v14 admission and independently settle terminal, reap, posthash, and unique-parent accounting evidence.
